summary.headline: Q2 FY27 presales rose 35% YoY to INR206 crores, while PAT fell to INR23 crores from INR33 crores; FY27 presales guidance kept at INR700 crores.
summary.overview: Suraj Estate reported Q2 FY27 sales value of INR206 crores (+35% YoY) and collections of INR104 crores (+46%), with H1 sales value of INR347 crores (+48%). Total income rose 18% YoY to INR171 crores, but EBITDA fell to INR56 crores from INR66 crores and PAT fell to INR23 crores from INR33 crores. Management reiterated FY27 presales guidance of INR700 crores and a launch pipeline of about INR1,600 crores, and said the Suraj One Business Bay GDV was raised to about INR2,000 crores after acquiring adjoining land rights. Net debt rose to INR710 crores, and management targets about INR600 crores by year-end.

segments.name: Suraj One Business Bay (commercial, Mahim)
segments.commentary: About INR500 crores of inventory sold since launch. Adjoining land rights acquired, lifting saleable area to 3.59 lakh sq ft and GDV to about INR2,000 crores (from INR1,200 crores). Second phase of about INR800 crores GDV targeted for launch by end-Q3 FY27.

segments.name: Residential (value luxury)
segments.commentary: Suraj Nova (Mahim West) and Suraj Madonna (Dadar West) have commencement certificates, with combined GDV of about INR250 crores. Both are targeted for launch and RERA registration in Q3 FY27.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales guidance reiterated at INR700 crores; H1 delivered INR347 crores, implying about INR353 crores needed in H2.

FY27 launch pipeline about INR1,600 crores: about INR800 crores commercial (Business Bay phase 2) and about INR800 crores residential. About INR1,050 crores planned for Q3 and about INR550 crores for Q4.
Net debt target of about INR600 crores by end-FY27, supported by handover of 5-6 projects expected to reduce debt by about INR150 crores.
Business Bay expansion: IOD for combined potential in process; environment clearance received; excavation and amalgamation of the additional plot expected within about 60 days.
capex_capacity: Ongoing projects: 13 sites, development area 23.54 lakh sq ft, saleable RERA carpet 7.57 lakh sq ft.
Upcoming pipeline: 18 projects, estimated carpet area 13.46 lakh sq ft.
Ongoing projects cumulative sold area 6.36 lakh sq ft at average realisation about INR46,170 per sq ft; unsold area 1.20 lakh sq ft with GDV about INR708 crores.
Bandra pipeline: all land acquisitions closed except one; some lands need Charity Commissioner and other approvals, which are underway.
Business Bay expansion: some basement and raft already cast on the first phase; CC received for first phase, work commenced.
demand_pricing: Sales value up 35% YoY in Q2 and 48% in H1; management attributes growth to residential and commercial projects, with commercial (Business Bay) cited as the key driver.
Collections of INR104 crores in Q2 (+46% YoY) and INR190 crores in H1 (vs INR186 crores in H1 FY26).
Payment plan: 20-30% on booking and 40-45% linked to plinth and construction, with no subvention.
Strategy: focus on value luxury 1 and 2 BHK residential and commercial in South Central Mumbai; avoiding ultra-luxury for now.
Redevelopment: evaluating a couple of society redevelopments (some in advanced stages) and one or two build-to-suit commercial deals.

qa_highlights.question: What contributes the INR353 crores of H2 presales needed to reach the INR700 crores guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said guidance relies mainly on launched ongoing projects plus a couple of upcoming residential components, with commercial (Business Bay) expected to drive much of the traction. No split was given.

qa_highlights.question: What are the approval and construction timelines for the expanded Business Bay project?
qa_highlights.answer: Concession plans and environment clearance are in hand; IOD for the combined potential is being issued. Only amalgamation and excavation of the additional component remain, expected within about 60 days.

qa_highlights.question: Has the FY27 INR1,600 crore launch pipeline changed in timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Launch plan is unchanged: about INR800 crores commercial (phase 2 of Business Bay) and INR250 crores residential targeted in Q3, with the remaining about INR550 crores in Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What is the cost of debt, the use of new borrowings and the leverage target?
qa_highlights.answer: Net debt rose about INR96 crores, mainly to acquire Business Bay adjoining development rights for about INR85 crores. Cost of debt is about 13-13.25%. Net debt target is about INR600 crores by year-end, helped by 5-6 project handovers worth about INR150 crores of debt reduction.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline to monetise the INR1,168 crores receivable from sold inventory?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give a timeline on the call; it offered to send IR a roughly one-year cash-flow schedule covering completed and ongoing projects.

qa_highlights.question: Are there other redevelopment opportunities and is the company looking outside South Central Mumbai?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is evaluating a couple of society redevelopments and one or two commercial build-to-suit deals, and it remains focused on South Central Mumbai to first execute its existing land inventory.

risks_watch: Profitability decline: Q2 EBITDA fell about 15% YoY and PAT about 30%, despite income growth of 18%.
H2 presales must reach about INR353 crores to meet the INR700 crores guidance; the commercial launch slipping past Q3 would weigh on this.
Leverage: net debt rose to INR710 crores; the INR600 crores target depends on project handovers and sales collections.
Receivables: INR1,168 crores balance receivable from sold inventory, with no monetisation timeline given on the call.
Approvals: Bandra pipeline still needs Charity Commissioner and other approvals; one land parcel is not yet acquired.
Business Bay expansion: excavation and amalgamation expected within about 60 days; execution timing risk.
summary.management_tone: Confident on sales momentum, the Business Bay expansion and launch timing, with reiterated guidance. Cautious and less specific on receivable monetisation and the Bandra land timeline, and did not address the fall in profit.

We are very confident we will launch by the end of this quarter.
So we are targeting to bring the net debt to close to INR600-odd crores by the end of financial year.
